Created the batch-5 scaffold artifacts in [frontier-25-batch-5.pages.json](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-25-batch-5.pages.json), [frontier-25-batch-5.coverage.json](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-25-batch-5.coverage.json), and [frontier-25-batch-5.notes.md](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-25-batch-5.notes.md). The manifest now carries a 19-item A page and 8-item B page, follows the live spec by adding `incidence-algebras-and-mobius-inversion` to the page `requires`, and keeps the already-published Möbius suppliers reused instead of duplicated. The coverage ledger records 55 harvested results across Shoup, Kedlaya, Crisman, and Sanders, and the notes explain the Hackman-source substitution, the finite-field closed-form carrier, and the choice to keep `1 * lambda` as a canonical scaffold row.

The structural gates are green: `coverage-checklist` passed with `1 page` and `55 harvested results`, whole-run `content-policy --manifest-only` passed with `269 scoped items`, `validate-plan` passed, and `git diff --check` on the three owned files is clean. The only remaining red gate is `source-fetch-check --stamp`: it failed `0/5` with `ENOTFOUND` on every external host in this sandbox, so I did not fabricate `fetch_verified` stamps. The exact failures are recorded in the notes, along with the fact that the recorded URLs were reopened through the web reader on Sunday, August 30, 2026.
